input.prompt: A new panel from the same hand-painted Srikalahasti kalamkari cloth as the reference image: match its palette, kalam line quality, dotted fill patterns, cotton weave texture and its lotus-and-vine border exactly. Photographed flat and straight-on so the cloth fills the entire frame edge to edge. The same dense ornamental border runs around all four edges: a lotus-and-vine scroll in ecru and madder between two thin dotted bands. Scene inside the border, a story panel: a seaside cafe terrace on a green hillside above the sea in the afternoon. In the foreground, large and central, a young man and a young woman sit facing each other at a small round table, deep in conversation, each holding a coffee cup, leaning in toward each other. The young man (left, drawn in profile facing right): short black hair, a neat short black beard, round spectacles, a checked shirt in indigo and ecru squares, trousers. The young woman (right, drawn in profile facing left): long black hair in a single long braid down her back, a simple plain top in myrobalan yellow with dotted pattern, and trousers. Both drawn in the classical kalamkari figure manner: side profile, large almond eyes, stylised hands with exactly five fingers each, flowing patterned drapery lines. To the left and right sides, smaller in scale, three friends sit around a low table with coffee cups, chatting: two on the left side, one on the right side. Behind them a low railing of the terrace with potted plants; beyond, green rolling hillside with palm trees, then the sea drawn as stylised rolling indigo waves with ecru crests and small patterned fish, two small boats with sails, and a large round afternoon sun in turmeric yellow with petal-like rays in the madder red sky ground. The background ground of the panel is dyed deep madder red. Style: freehand kalam (bamboo pen) outlines in iron-black with confident, slightly irregular line weight; flat natural vegetable-dye fills only: deep madder red, brick red, indigo blue, myrobalan-turmeric yellow, green made from indigo over yellow, and undyed ecru cotton; dense hand-drawn fill patterns of dots, cross-hatching, scales and tiny petals; visible hand-woven cotton weave and slight dye bleed at colour edges. Completely flat, no perspective shading, no gradients, no metallic gold, no 3D, no photorealism. Exactly five people in total: two main figures and three small friends. No text, no letters, no writing, no numbers, no signboard, no cafe sign, no menu, no logos, no lamps, no diyas, no candles, no fire, no flames.
